# Approval

`import { Approval } from "@/components/agent-ui/approval"`

## Use for
- Pausing an agent until the user allows or denies one concrete action.

## Do not use for
- Generic "are you sure" dialogs outside the agent thread. Use the project's `AlertDialog`.
- Asking the user a free-form question. That is a normal assistant `Message`.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Required. What the agent wants to do, as a sentence: "Run a shell command". |
| `command` | `string` | Exact command, path or payload. Shown in mono and kept after the decision. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | Why, or what it will affect. |
| `onApprove` | `({ always }) => void` | Required. `always` is the "don't ask again" checkbox. |
| `onDeny` | `() => void` | Required. |
| `allowAlways` | `boolean` | Shows the checkbox. Only for actions that are safe to auto-approve later. |
| `state` | `"pending" \| "approved" \| "denied"` | Pass to control it, e.g. when restoring a transcript. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | Focus Allow on mount. Only for the newest approval in a live run, never when restoring history. |
| `approveLabel`, `denyLabel`, `approvedLabel`, `deniedLabel`, `alwaysLabel` | `string` | UI copy. Set them when the interface is not in English. |

## Example
```tsx
<Approval
  title="Run a shell command"
  command="rm -rf ./build"
  description="Deletes the build folder before rebuilding."
  onApprove={({ always }) => resume(call.id, { allow: true, always })}
  onDeny={() => resume(call.id, { allow: false })}
/>
```

## Rules
- Always show the exact `command`. Never ask for approval of a vague summary.
- Do not set `allowAlways` for destructive or paid actions.
- While an Approval is pending, show `AgentDock` with `status="waiting"`.
